Base Period of a Group-Time Cell

Source: R/subset_functions.R
pte_base_period.Rd

The base period for the cell of group g in period tp, as in did::att_gt(). Post-treatment cells (tp at least g - anticipation, in calendar time) and all cells with a universal base period use the last period p with p + anticipation < g; pre-treatment cells with a varying base period use the period just before tp. Used by two_by_two_subset(); useful for custom subset functions.

Usage

pte_base_period(data, g, tp, anticipation = 0, base_period = "varying")

Arguments

data

the full data from a setup function (e.g. ptep$data)

g

the group (internal period index of first treatment)

tp

the current period (internal period index)

anticipation

anticipation, in units of the time variable

base_period

"varying" or "universal"

Value

the base period as an internal period index, or NA if group g has no period early enough to serve as its base period
